summary: This directory defines the structural schemas and TypeScript types used for documenting and modeling the architectural intent of directories and packages within a project.
responsibilities: Define schemas for capturing architectural metadata about directories
Define schemas for modeling package capabilities and relationships
Provide TypeScript types for structural concept modeling
relationships: Package concepts aggregate multiple architectural properties including summaries, responsibilities, and design decisions.
Directory concepts serve as a structural blueprint for documenting the intent of specific project folders.
Capability and relationship schemas provide granular detail for broader package-level architectural descriptions.
designDecisions: Composition of smaller schemas into comprehensive package and directory models
Strict separation of type definitions and schema runtime definitions
